newsitem.title: SPAIN: Canal Satelite says files complaint vs Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Canal Satelite says files complaint vs Telefonica.

text.p: Canal Satelite Digital, the Canal Plus backed digital television platform in Spain, said late Thursday it was filing a complaint with the European Union Competition Commission against Telefonica de Espana.
Telefonica leads the rival Via Digital platform.

Canal Satelite said it was protesting at Telefonica's purchase of a 25 percent stake in Antena 3 television station and a controlling stake in its GMA subsidiary. It said the Antena 3 buy represented an abuse of Telefonica's dominant position and contravened the Treaty of Rome.
Telefonica's Antena 3 purchase will give it a indirect 15 percent stake in Canal Satelite itself, as well as access to lucrative football rights.
Industry analysts say the soccer rights are crucial to make the investment-heavy platforms profitable.
The commission should urgently open an infringment case against the Spanish telecoms giant, Canal Satelite said.
